portfolioChecklist.title: End-to-End AI Automation
portfolioChecklist.description: A complete AI automation workflow that solves a real problem from start to finish.
criteria: Uses LLMs for core intelligence (OpenAI, Claude, or open-source)
Integrates with at least 2 external APIs or services
Includes error handling and retry logic
proofPoints: Live deployed URL or demo video
GitHub repository with clean code and README
Screenshot or recording of the workflow in action

portfolioChecklist.title: Multi-Agent System
portfolioChecklist.description: A working multi-agent system where AI agents collaborate on a complex task.
criteria: Uses at least 2 distinct agent roles (e.g., planner, researcher, coder)
Includes tool integration (APIs, databases, file systems)
proofPoints: Working demo with agent communication logs
Documentation explaining agent roles and workflow

portfolioChecklist.title: RAG-Powered Knowledge System
portfolioChecklist.description: A retrieval-augmented generation system that answers questions from custom data.
criteria: Indexes and retrieves from a custom document set
Uses embeddings and vector storage (ChromaDB, FAISS, or similar)
Produces accurate, grounded responses from retrieved context
Includes a user-facing interface (chat, search, or API)
proofPoints: Demo showing question-answering over custom documents
Code showing chunking, embedding, and retrieval pipeline
Example queries and responses demonstrating accuracy
